remarks:
Welcome home to 1436 Losson Road! This well-kept brick-front ranch has 3 bedrooms and 1.5 baths, all on one floor, on a deep lot with a wooded backdrop. Shopping, dining and everyday errands are just minutes away.

Step inside to a bright living room with a soaring vaulted ceiling, newer carpet (2023) and a sliding door out to the deck. The eat-in kitchen has plenty of cabinetry, including a full-height pantry cabinet, a gas range and a pass-through to the living room, so the cook stays part of the conversation. There’s room for a full dining table with a ceiling fan overhead.

The primary bedroom also has a vaulted ceiling and a ceiling fan. The other two bedrooms are good sizes and work well as guest rooms or a home office. The full bath has a walk-in shower, and a convenient half bath is off the hall. The full basement gives you plenty of storage and room to grow.

Out back, the deck steps down to a paver patio (2017) with a built-in fire pit. It’s the perfect spot for summer cookouts and fall bonfires, looking out over a big, fenced backyard lined with mature trees. Out front you’ll find a landscaped yard, a covered front porch with newer railing (2020), a long driveway and an attached two-car garage.

Move-in ready and lovingly maintained. Showings begin Wednesday 10/21
